reddit.title: Introducing New Movement Mechanics in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share our latest development update on movement mechanics in Provincia! We've made significant changes to how units interact during battles. Now, formations will turn and march without teleporting, ensuring a more realistic experience. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ranks-that-turn-and-march?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ranks-that-turn-and-march
